description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Strago)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Strago)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Tidal Flow after using Water abilities (max 3 chases)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Strago)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Strago)] from the user
